WELCOME: Welcome to the POMEIL Project! Empowering Immigrants and Refugees through Innovative Learning
WELCOME_EXTENDED: The POMEIL project is dedicated to addressing the challenges that immigrants and refugees face in accessing the labor market and achieving socioeconomic integration in their host countries. With millions of people migrating to the EU each year, disparities in employment, social inclusion, and access to education remain significant. POMEIL tackles these issues by providing innovative, digital-based learning tools designed to foster entrepreneurial and cross-cultural skills.

QUESTIONNAIRE.TITLE: Evaluation Questionnaire for the MOOC Platform
QUESTIONNAIRE.PURPOSE: This questionnaire helps us evaluate your experience with the POMEIL training and improve the learning materials and methods.
QUESTIONNAIRE.SCALE_HINT: Use the 1–5 scale: 1 = Strongly disagree, 5 = Strongly agree.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_DIGITAL_EASY: The online training (escape room & module) was easy for me to follow.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_DIGITAL_TOOLS: The digital tools and materials helped me understand the content.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_DIGITAL_CONFIDENCE_AFTER: I feel more confident using digital learning tools after completing the MOOC.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_ENGAGEMENT_ACTIVITIES: The MOOC activities helped me learn in an engaging way.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_ENGAGEMENT_ESCAPE_ROOM: The escape room format made the learning experience more interactive.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_INTERCULTURAL_UNDERSTANDING: The MOOC improved my understanding of intercultural competence.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_INTERCULTURAL: I feel more confident interacting with people from different backgrounds.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_USABILITY_EASE: The platform was easy to use.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_USABILITY_CLARITY: The lessons and materials were clear and well organized.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_USABILITY_NOISSUES: I did not face technical problems when using the platform.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_IMPACT_RELEVANT: The content was relevant to my professional situation (current or future).
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_IMPACT_USEFUL: The training helped me develop useful skills (cross-cultural and entrepreneurial).
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_IMPACT_CAREER: I feel more confident about my future work opportunities.
QUESTIONNAIRE.Q_OVERALL_SATISFACTION: Overall, I am satisfied with the MOOC experience.

GUIDE.TITLE: Guide
GUIDE.ROOM_TITLE: How to play an escape room
GUIDE.ROOM_STEP_1: Read the short story on the intro card, then click Start.
GUIDE.ROOM_STEP_2: Explore the scene: click objects that look interesting and talk to the characters — they tell you what to look for.
GUIDE.ROOM_STEP_3: Click the dialogue box to continue a conversation.
GUIDE.ROOM_STEP_4: Stuck? Press the glowing lightbulb button (top-left) for a hint. After a while the game also nudges you.
GUIDE.ROOM_STEP_5: Puzzles allow 3 attempts; after the third wrong attempt the answer is shown. You can also skip a puzzle.
GUIDE.ROOM_STEP_6: In the learning flow every puzzle counts towards your score: 80% or more passes; below that, study the module before moving on.
GUIDE.ROOM_STEP_7: Tip: play on a laptop or desktop in fullscreen (the button in the top-right corner) for the best experience.
GUIDE.ROTATE_HINT: For the best experience, turn your phone to landscape or use a larger screen.

SKILL_DESC.cultural-awareness: Understanding and respecting cultural differences in the workplace, including communication styles, customs, and social norms across cultures.
SKILL_DESC.empathy: Developing the ability to recognize and understand the emotions and perspectives of others, and responding with compassion in professional settings.
SKILL_DESC.strategic-thinking: Learning to analyze situations, consider long-term impacts, and make decisions that align with organizational goals and team collaboration.
SKILL_DESC.open-mindedness: Cultivating openness to new ideas, diverse perspectives, and constructive feedback while maintaining critical thinking abilities.
SKILL_DESC.financial: Understanding basic financial concepts including budgeting, cash flow management, invoicing, and financial planning for personal and professional growth.
SKILL_DESC.stress-management: Techniques for recognizing, managing, and reducing stress in the workplace, including mindfulness, boundary-setting, and resilience building.
SKILL_DESC.trust-building: Building trust within teams through transparency, empathy, active listening, and consistent leadership behavior.
SKILL_DESC.active-listening: Being fully present in conversations, understanding verbal and non-verbal cues, and responding thoughtfully to build stronger communication.
SKILL_DESC.adaptability: Adjusting your approach when circumstances change while maintaining focus on goals, balancing speed with judgment.
SKILL_DESC.flexibility: Responding quickly to change, managing stress, and finding new solutions under pressure in dynamic R&D environments.
SKILL_DESC.interpersonal-skills: Communication, teamwork, emotional intelligence, and problem-solving abilities essential for effective workplace interactions.
SKILL_DESC.language-skills: Developing receptive and productive language abilities for effective communication in international professional environments.
SKILL_DESC.resilience: Building the capacity to recover from setbacks, adapt to challenges, and maintain effectiveness under pressure.
SKILL_DESC.self-reliance: Developing independence, initiative, and confidence to solve problems and make decisions autonomously.
SKILL_DESC.teamwork: Working effectively with others, collaborating across roles, and contributing to shared goals in diverse team environments.
SKILL_DESC.tolerance: Understanding and accepting diversity, practicing inclusion, and managing differences constructively in the workplace.
SKILL_DESC.crm: Managing customer interactions, handling complaints, maintaining records, and building long-term customer relationships.
SKILL_DESC.decision-making: Systematic approaches to identifying alternatives, evaluating outcomes, and selecting the best course of action under uncertainty.
SKILL_DESC.leadership: Developing leadership qualities including empathy, accountability, communication, and decision-making in team management.
SKILL_DESC.legal-compliance: Understanding legal requirements, data protection, confidentiality, and ethical responsibilities in business operations.
SKILL_DESC.market-awareness: Understanding target audiences, competitor analysis, market trends, and developing unique selling propositions.
SKILL_DESC.motivating-others: Recognizing strengths, providing encouragement, and inspiring confidence in others through empathetic leadership.
SKILL_DESC.business-planning: Developing business models, identifying customer segments, revenue streams, and creating actionable business plans.
SKILL_DESC.critical-thinking: Analyzing information objectively, evaluating evidence, and making reasoned judgments to solve problems effectively.
SKILL_DESC.digital-skills: Navigating digital tools, cybersecurity awareness, online communication, and responsible use of technology in the workplace.
SKILL_DESC.negotiation-skills: Preparing for negotiations, building rapport, finding win-win solutions, and maintaining professional relationships.
SKILL_DESC.networking-skills: Initiating professional connections, building trust, maintaining relationships, and leveraging networks for opportunities.
SKILL_DESC.risk-management: Identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks in the workplace, including safety hazards and operational risks.
SKILL_DESC.problem-solving: Defining problems accurately before acting — avoiding jumping to solutions, exploring alternative causes, and identifying root issues.
SKILL_DESC.project-management: Setting clear objectives, balancing stakeholder needs, protecting project scope, and communicating realistic priorities to deliver on time.
